tell me how can i comment an entire paragraph

In LaTeX, you have a few good options:

- **Single-line comments:** put `%` at the start of each line:
  ```tex
  % This whole paragraph is commented out.
  % LaTeX will ignore every line that starts with percent.
  % Nothing here will appear in the PDF.
  ```

- **Fast block comment with `comment` package:** add this in the preamble:
  ```tex
  \usepackage{comment}
  ```
  Then wrap the paragraph:
  ```tex
  \begin{comment}
  This entire paragraph is ignored by LaTeX.
  It can span multiple lines.
  Equations and citations inside are also ignored.
  \end{comment}
  ```

- **No extra package:** use `\iffalse ... \fi`:
  ```tex
  \iffalse
  This entire paragraph is commented out.
  It can span multiple lines.
  \fi
  ```

I’d recommend `\iffalse ... \fi` for quick temporary comments, or `%` if it’s only a few lines.

is there a way to shorten the url i inserted in 5.8 section
I’ll check section 5.8 to see the URL formatting and suggest the cleanest LaTeX fix.

Yes. Since you already load `hyperref`, replace the long visible URL with a short clickable label using `\href{...}{...}`.

For your line in section 5.8, change:

```tex
here \url{https://github.com/MiguelICN/Spin-transport/tree/main}.
```

to something like:

```tex
here \href{https://github.com/MiguelICN/Spin-transport/tree/main}{the project repository}.
```

So the PDF will show only **“the project repository”**, but it will still be clickable.

Other options:

```tex
\href{https://github.com/MiguelICN/Spin-transport/tree/main}{GitHub repository}
```

or

```tex
\footnote{\url{https://github.com/MiguelICN/Spin-transport/tree/main}}
```

Best option for readability: use `\href{...}{GitHub repository}`.
